When will Apple officially announce the date for the iPhone 18 Pro launch event? Although Apple has not yet sent out invitations, based on the pattern of previous announcement dates, we can estimate a fairly accurate time frame.

Apple iPhone launch event announcement dates: 2020–2025

For four consecutive years, Apple officially announced the date exactly two weeks before the iPhone launch event. Below are the announcement dates for Apple's past six iPhone launch events, and what these data points suggest for September 2026.

Model Event announcement Event date Delta iPhone 17 Tuesday, August 26, 2025 Tuesday, September 9, 2025 14 days iPhone 16 Monday, August 26, 2024 Monday, September 9, 2024 14 days iPhone 15 Tuesday, August 29, 2023 Tuesday, September 12, 2023 14 days iPhone 14 Wednesday, August 24, 2022 Wednesday, September 7, 2022 14 days iPhone 13 Tuesday, September 7, 2021 Tuesday, September 14, 2021 7 days iPhone 12 Tuesday, October 6, 2020 Tuesday, October 13, 2020 7 days

The pandemic in 2020 and 2021 disrupted Apple's usual iPhone launch event schedule. The iPhone 12 launch event was pushed back to October, while both the iPhone 12 and iPhone 13 launch events were announced just 7 days in advance.

However, since 2022, Apple's approach has been remarkably consistent, with every iPhone launch event announced exactly 14 days beforehand.

When will the iPhone 18 Pro / iPhone Ultra launch event be held?

Apple has not yet officially announced the date of its next iPhone launch event, but the most likely date at present is Wednesday, September 9.

Apple provided the first official clue this week, beginning to accept applications from US retail store employees to serve as staff for the event support experience programme, to be held in California. Apple has notified employees that the event will take place in the first half of September.

Bloomberg points out that a Wednesday is slightly more likely, as September 7 is Labour Day. Holding the event on a Wednesday would allow Apple to maintain its usual arrangement, enabling attending guests to travel to and from the venue on weekdays.

When will Apple announce the date of the new iPhone launch event?

If Apple maintains its pattern of the past four years and holds the launch event on September 9, the date would be officially announced two weeks beforehand, that is, on Wednesday, August 26.

Therefore, August 26 is the strongest predicted day for the Apple iPhone 18 launch event invitation. Tuesday, August 25 is another possibility, but this would create a 15-day gap, failing to extend Apple's recent 14-day pattern.

What to look out for at Apple's September 2026 launch event

This year's product lineup will make this launch event particularly noteworthy. Apple is expected to unveil three new flagship iPhones: the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone (possibly named iPhone Ultra).

The standard iPhone 18 will be notably absent. Apple is expected to split its product release schedule starting from this cycle, pushing back the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 to a spring 2027 launch.

September has historically been the time when Apple unveils its new Apple Watch hardware. AirPods occasionally make an appearance at the launch event, but they do not receive an update every year.

This launch event also marks another first for Apple. John Ternus will take over as CEO on September 1, while Tim Cook will transition to the role of Executive Chairman of the Board, marking this as the first iPhone launch event of the Ternus era.
